text:
Mira Patel: quick thread 1: experimenting with a scan-friendly label: small inline 'Req' pill after label (low emphasis) + optional underline on focus. trying to balance declutter vs discoverability. mock: https://figma.redwood/company/req-pill

Priya Desai: I like the explicit short word vs a symbol. two accessibility thoughts: (1) make sure mobile shows something (no hover), (2) screen readers still need `aria-required=\"true\"` on inputs.

Omar Hargrove: agree. for scanning users, the pill may read as part of the label visually. can we test contrast and also try a subtle left border on the form column to help eyes find required cluster?

Alex Morgan: dev notes: show the pill always on mobile (reduced weight), desktop reveal underline + tooltip on hover. validation: inline errors on blur for non-empty invalid values; wait until submit for empty required fields. link inputs to errors with `aria-describedby` and mark errors with `role=alert` when they appear.

Kevin Liu: accessibility checklist: set `aria-required=\"true\"`, use `aria-invalid=\"true\"` on fail, ensure the error text is announced (role=alert) but avoid duplicate announcements when we also have a summary. for summary links use `tabindex=-1` and `element.focus()` to move SR focus.

Mira Patel: on destructive confirmations: keeping typed-confirm for org/workspace level. for row-level deletes use checkbox + modal. always surface copy: "Type the workspace name to confirm" vs generic DELETE. include undo snackbar where possible (6-8s).

Priya Desai: copy nit: pill text should be "Req" for compact, but in helper aria-label we say "required" so SRs read full word. good balance.

Omar Hargrove: analytics ask: A/B the pill vs asterisk with a small cohort, metrics: empty-submit rate, time-to-complete, and support mentions referencing required fields.

design-bot: reminder: add this thread to Thu design review agenda. :spiral_calendar:

Mira Patel: thanks 1 everyone. action items: design to tweak pill + mobile fallback (Priya + Mira), eng to wire ARIA + error announcements (Alex + Kevin), analytics to spec A/B (Omar). I'll post updated frames by Wed.
